name: Fire Storm
description: Level 7 Evocation (Doctor, Druid, Tidecaller) Casting Time: Action Range: 150 feet Components: V, S Duration: Instantaneous A storm of fire appears within range. The area of the storm consists of up to ten 10-foot Cubes, which you arrange as you like. Each Cube must be contiguous with at least one other Cube. Each creature in the area makes a Agility saving throw, taking 7d10 Fire damage on a failed save or half as much damage on a successful one. Flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried start burning.
